titre: All Paranormal and Creepy missions in GTA 6
chapo: All of GTA 6's weird and creepy missions
extrait: GTA 6 is full of paranormal and creepy side missions that plenty of players may have missed. While you’ll spend much of your time in GTA 6 robbing banks and completing missions, it also has plenty of hidden secrets and complex missions worth exploring. This this hub, we’ve brought together all the strangest missions in the game, all of which we’ve published extensive guides for. Whether you’re hunting for aliens, investigating government cover-ups or looking for something lurking in Leonida’s swamps, here’s how to uncover the creepiest mysteries in GTA 6. Spoiler warning: Some entries reveal hidden encounters, story details and rewards. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub, featuringÂ beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more. Reward: The Truth Is Out There trophy and permanent stat boosts The GTA 6 UFO encounter begins with an abandoned car found on a deserted road at night. Following a trail of clothing leads to a mysterious woman suspended in a UFO’s light. But that’s only the beginning. The encounter triggers a series of strange dreams, puzzles and a secret underground facility where players can eventually encounter an actual extraterrestrial. GTA 6’s Leonida has its own version of Bigfoot, known as the Skunk Ape, and Rockstar has given the legendary creature its own storyline in GTA 6. Jason can team up with a local cryptid hunter named Kirk to investigate reports of a mysterious creature known as Mr Mangrove. The three-part questline involves tracking the creature through the swamps, investigating strange tree effigies and eventually discovering the truth behind the legend. There’s also a difficult decision to make at the end of the investigation, with different outcomes depending on whether you shoot Kirk, Mr Mangrove or neither. This easily missable Silent Hill Easter egg is one of the strangest in the game. The hotel is particularly unsettling compared with the usual sights of Vice City, and there’s a hidden safe that makes exploring the building worthwhile.
